source: South Korea, on average, featured the oldest historical figures: all four of them lived in the 13th and 14th centuries.
why: The four South Korean individuals in the file died in 1450, 1551, 1570 and 1584 (15th-16th centuries), not the 13th-14th. Tunisia also has an earlier mean death year because of Hannibal, so South Korea is not the oldest on a straight average.
